summary: Completed comprehensive regression testing of AI assistant panel redesign. All core features working correctly: assistant entry button, panel structure with three groups (REWRITE/EXTRACT/ORGANISE), tone control with 5 options, all 7 action rows functional, result surfaces with apply buttons, status indicators, streaming Q&A, guardrail for empty notes, and responsive layouts in both light/dark themes.
passed_tests: Assistant entry button (data-testid=open-ai-btn) with Sparkles icon, 'Assist' label, and ⌘/Ctrl E kbd hint
Control+E keyboard shortcut toggles assistant panel open/closed
Panel structure with three labeled groups: REWRITE, EXTRACT, ORGANISE
All 7 action rows present and clickable: improve, continue, tone, summarize, action-items, title, suggest-tags
Tone control chip (data-testid=ai-tone-select) with 5 options: Professional/Casual/Concise/Confident/Academic
Tone action with 'Concise' produces result surface (data-testid=ai-result-tone) with label mentioning chosen tone
Replace note button (data-testid=ai-replace-note-btn) updates note content
Note content persists after page reload
Improve action produces result (data-testid=ai-result-improve) with Try again button
Continue action produces result (data-testid=ai-result-continue) with insert button (data-testid=ai-insert-continue-btn)
Summarize action produces result (data-testid=ai-result-summarize) with insert button (data-testid=ai-insert-summarize-btn)
Action items produces result (data-testid=ai-result-action-items) with insert button (data-testid=ai-insert-action-items-btn)
Action items insert creates real checklist (ul[data-type=taskList] with 6 checkboxes)
Title suggestion produces result (data-testid=ai-result-title) with apply button (data-testid=ai-apply-title-btn)
Apply title button updates note-title-input value correctly
Suggest tags produces result (data-testid=ai-result-suggest-tags) with apply button (data-testid=ai-apply-tags-btn)
Apply tags button attaches tags (tag chips appear in sidebar)
Status indicator shows 'Thinking' with pulsing dot during actions
Status indicator returns to 'Ready' after action completes
Empty state displays 'Nothing running' when no action is active
Streaming Q&A: question typed in ai-question-input, sent via ai-ask-btn
Answer streams into ai-chat-thread and persists after closing/reopening assistant
Clear chat button (data-testid=ai-clear-chat-btn) clears conversation
Guardrail: empty note triggers error toast, panel returns to Ready without crashing
Layout quality at 1920x900: no horizontal overflow, tone chip doesn't overlap label
Layout quality at 414x840 (mobile): tone row visible, send button positioned inside input field
Dark theme: assistant panel has solid background (rgb(25, 28, 36))
Light theme: assistant panel renders correctly
No React error overlay during any test
